PORTFOLIO

Phantom Tse谢旭宇

My work spans visual design, brand management and entrepreneurship. I listen closely, then shape a direction around the product and its audience. I’m particular about detail, with firm expectations for brand recognition and the quality of the finished work.

从视觉设计、品牌管理到创业，我习惯先听清需求，再决定设计往哪里走。我关心设计能否帮助产品被理解、被选择；对细节有些强迫症，对品牌识别和作品的完成度，也有不愿妥协的坚持。

Once a piece is finished, much of the discussion behind it disappears. Why this direction? Which details were worth keeping, and which ideas were set aside? These notes share some of the thinking behind my design work.

作品完成之后，许多讨论和取舍就看不见了。为什么选这个方向，哪些细节坚持留下，哪些想法最后放弃——这里记下我做设计时的一些考虑。
